'''Yumi Takada''' (Japanese: '''高田由美''' ''Takada Yumi'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Takada was born on September 21, 1961, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She became a voice actress as an adult and led a prolific career since the late 1970s, until her retirement in 2009. Takada joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|GS}}, providing her voice for [[character of the day]] [[Trixie]]. She then voiced [[Pokémon Contest]] announcer [[Vivian Meridian]] during {{aniseries|RS}}. Takada was affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}} prior to her retirement.
